label: ➕ Vector arithmetic
description: Element-wise arithmetic on vector (array of numeric) columns. Add or subtract two vector columns, scale a vector by a constant, compute the magnitude, or L2-normalise a vector. Use cases: sensor fusion, embedding arithmetic, feature engineering for ML.

op.label: Operation
op.help: add/subtract/multiply/divide: element-wise between two vector columns of equal length. scalar_*: apply a constant to every element. normalize_l2: divide each element by the vector's L2 norm. magnitude: scalar L2 norm of the vector.

leftColumn.label: Vector column
leftColumn.help: The (left) vector column. Required for every operation.

rightColumn.label: Right vector column
rightColumn.help: Required for add / subtract / multiply / divide. Ignored for scalar_*, normalize_l2, magnitude.

scalar.label: Scalar
scalar.help: The constant to apply for scalar_multiply / scalar_add.
